name: Forliamuk
backstory: Child of Forliazco and Farmuken, in Terfila; grew up around walks the transit route between Terfila and the..., and picked up a little of Birth Of Niergus along the way.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Trezco and Tamuken now have a child, Tamuzco.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliauzco.
Had a child with Forliauzco, named Forliauken.
Had a child with Tamuzco, named Tamuzaken.
Heard that Trezarlo and Forliukar now have a child, Trezukar.
Heard that Forliauzco and Farliazco now have a child, Forliuzazco.
Heard that Tamuzco and Farliukar now have a child, Tamuzarlo.
Heard that Forliauken and Trezukar now have a child, Forliaukar.
Heard that Tamuzco and Farliazco now have a child, Farliuzco.
Had a child with Tamuzco, named Tamuzmuken.

criterion.standard: measures a life by whether Death Of Dorakus is still remembered rightly
criterion.wasted_life: forgetting what Death Of Dorakus actually meant, the way most people already have
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: walks the transit route on his own errands when the harbor's dead time drags on, and can't pass the temple without pausing, the way the family always has.

arc.premise: Forliamuk wants to find whoever actually witnessed that birth and get their account carried properly along the transit route, before the secondhand version is all that's left.
